Summary: Admin user-list API exposes password hashes
Description: GET /api/users returns a password property containing each user's bcrypt hash. See defects/BUG-001-password-hashes-exposed.md.

Summary: Customer can view another customer's complete order
Description: A second authenticated customer receives HTTP 200 and full order details for another customer's order ID. See defects/BUG-002-cross-customer-order-disclosure.md.
Order line shows 3 x $89.99 = $269.96999999999997 while summary shows $269.97. See defects/BUG-003-order-line-floating-point.md.

Summary: Storefront page-2 control does not navigate
Description: Clicking pagination control 2 leaves the URL and four page-1 products unchanged. See defects/BUG-004-storefront-pagination-does-not-navigate.md.

Summary: Interactive catalog and quantity controls lack accessible names
Description: Catalog image links and product quantity select lack accessible names. See defects/BUG-005-missing-accessible-names.md.

Summary: Text and controls fail minimum color contrast
Description: axe reports insufficient contrast across all five scanned pages. See defects/BUG-006-insufficient-color-contrast.md.
